Even so, Killian's been breathing down my neck, and I'm starting to take it# personal. 【Gizmo snorts】 And that's where you come in, slick.

entries.text: You're a liar!

entries.text: 你撒谎！

entries.text: You're right. Goodbye.

entries.text: 你是对的。再见。

entries.text: I don't know who you are, but I don't take kindly to strangers walking into my office and accusing me of things they know nothing about.
entries.source_text: I don't know who you are, but I don't take kindly to strangers walking into my office and accusing me of things they know nothing about.

entries.text: 我不知道你是谁，但我对于那些走进我办公室，就他们一无所知的事情控告我的陌生人从不客气。
entries.source_text: 我不知道你是谁，但我对于那些走进我办公室，就他们一无所知的事情控告我的陌生人从不客气。

entries.text: Ah, but there's where you miss the point, Gizmo. I'm not accusing. I'm here to help you.
entries.source_text: Ah, but there's where you miss the point, Gizmo. I'm not accusing. I'm here to help you.

entries.text: 哦，但你遗漏了一点，吉斯莫。我不是来控告的。我是来帮助你的。
entries.source_text: 哦，但你遗漏了一点，吉斯莫。我不是来控告的。我是来帮助你的。

entries.text: I know it all. So confess!
entries.source_text: I know it all. So confess!

entries.text: 我全都知道了。所以承认了吧！
entries.source_text: 我全都知道了。所以承认了吧！

entries.text: You're right. I'm leaving.
entries.source_text: You're right. I'm leaving.

entries.text: 你是对的。我马上就离开。
entries.source_text: 你是对的。我马上就离开。

entries.text: Really? 【Gizmo chuckles.】 He's gonna help me? What kinda help are we talking about?
entries.source_text: Really? 【Gizmo chuckles.】 He's gonna help me? What kinda help are we talking about?

entries.text: 是嘛？【吉斯莫咯咯地笑着对艾佐说】他准备帮助我？【转过头看着你】你能帮什么样的忙呢？
entries.source_text: 是嘛？【吉斯莫咯咯地笑着对艾佐说】他准备帮助我？【转过头看着你】你能帮什么样的忙呢？

entries.text: Easy. You sent someone to kill Killian. He failed. You need someone who can do the job . . . better.
entries.source_text: Easy. You sent someone to kill Killian. He failed. You need someone who can do the job . . . better.

entries.text: 很简单。你派了人去杀基利安。他失败了。你需要更厉害的家伙来做这件事。
entries.source_text: 很简单。你派了人去杀基利安。他失败了。你需要更厉害的家伙来做这件事。

entries.text: Nothing. Forget I brought it up.
entries.source_text: Nothing. Forget I brought it up.

entries.text: 没什么。忘了我提起过这事吧。
entries.source_text: 没什么。忘了我提起过这事吧。

entries.text: And let me guess. You're that someone?
entries.source_text: And let me guess. You're that someone?

entries.text: 还有，让我猜。你就是那家伙？
entries.source_text: 还有，让我猜。你就是那家伙？

entries.text: Very good . . . For a price, of course.
entries.source_text: Very good . . . For a price, of course.

entries.text: 没错……当然，勤劳致富，有偿劳动。
entries.source_text: 没错……当然，勤劳致富，有偿劳动。

entries.text: I can kill him quicker than you can spit.
entries.source_text: I can kill him quicker than you can spit.

entries.text: 你吐口口水的时间我就能杀掉他。
entries.source_text: 你吐口口水的时间我就能杀掉他。

entries.text: Well, how can I trust you?
entries.source_text: Well, how can I trust you?

entries.text: 好吧，我怎么才能相信你？
entries.source_text: 好吧，我怎么才能相信你？

entries.text: I'm here. And you need someone from out of town to do your dirty work. Right?
entries.source_text: I'm here. And you need someone from out of town to do your dirty work. Right?

entries.text: 你需要这个镇以外的人来帮你干点见不得人的事儿。而我恰好在这儿。对吧？
entries.source_text: 你需要这个镇以外的人来帮你干点见不得人的事儿。而我恰好在这儿。对吧？

entries.text: You can't . . . I mean you can . . . I mean . . .
entries.source_text: You can't . . . I mean you can . . . I mean . . .

entries.text: 你不能……我的意思是你能……我的意思是……
entries.source_text: 你不能……我的意思是你能……我的意思是……

entries.text: Because I've been around. I've killed before.
entries.source_text: Because I've been around. I've killed before.

entries.text: 因为我在外面混过，干过湿活。
entries.source_text: 因为我在外面混过，干过湿活。

entries.text: Hmm . . . all right. We can do this. But you work for me, you better know# that nobody ever double-crosses Gizmo and lives to talk about it. You got me?
entries.source_text:

entries.text: 呣……好吧。我们就这么干吧。但既然你为我工作，就最好记得，没人能耍了吉斯莫之后还能活着的。明白了吗？
entries.source_text: 呣……好吧。我们就这么干吧。但既然你为我工作，就最好记得，没人能耍了吉斯莫之后还能活着的。明白了吗？

entries.text: Oh, I could put one over on you . . . just no way anyone could put one 'round you.
entries.source_text: Oh, I could put one over on you . . . just no way anyone could put one 'round you.

entries.text: 哦，我把你耍了……谁都没有这么耍过你。
entries.source_text: 哦，我把你耍了……谁都没有这么耍过你。

entries.text: Of course. But first I need to know why you want him dead.
entries.source_text: Of course. But first I need to know why you want him dead.

entries.text: 当然。但是首先我要知道为什么你要他死。
entries.source_text: 当然。但是首先我要知道为什么你要他死。

entries.text: Huh. That's easy. I want him dead because he cramps my business. So, will you do him for me?
entries.source_text: Huh. That's easy. I want him dead because he cramps my business. So, will you do him for me?

entries.text: 啊哈。很简单。他挡住了我的财路，我就要他死。那么，你愿意帮我做掉他吗？
entries.source_text: 啊哈。很简单。他挡住了我的财路，我就要他死。那么，你愿意帮我做掉他吗？

entries.text: That's why I'm here. He'll be dead before sundown.
entries.source_text: That's why I'm here. He'll be dead before sundown.

entries.text: 那就是我在这儿的原因。日落之前他就会死。
entries.source_text: 那就是我在这儿的原因。日落之前他就会死。

entries.text: Sure. It's a job.
entries.source_text: Sure. It's a job.

entries.text: 那是当然。那么这活儿就说定了。
entries.source_text: 那是当然。那么这活儿就说定了。

entries.text: Could you say that again please . . . this time in my coat pocket?
entries.source_text: Could you say that again please . . . this time in my coat pocket?

entries.text: 请再说一遍可以吗……我这里的录音机还没录好哇。
entries.source_text: 请再说一遍可以吗……我这里的录音机还没录好哇。

entries.text: Well, um . . . No, I can't.
entries.source_text: Well, um . . . No, I can't.

entries.text: 好吧，呃……不，我不能。
entries.source_text: 好吧，呃……不，我不能。

entries.text: Good. Return with the dog tags he wears around his neck as proof.# And we never had this conversation, you don't mention this to anyone. No one double crosses me. No one.

entries.text: You're either real stupid . . . or a real stupid spy. Doesn't matter, because now Izo's gonna make you real dead.
entries.source_text: You're either real stupid . . . or a real stupid spy. Doesn't matter, because now Izo's gonna make you real dead.

entries.text: 你要么是真傻……要么就是个笨得可以的奸细。没关系，因为现在艾佐马上会让你死透的。
entries.source_text: 你要么是真傻……要么就是个笨得可以的奸细。没关系，因为现在艾佐马上会让你死透的。

entries.text: I don't like people who waste my time. Don't come back again soon!
entries.source_text: I don't like people who waste my time. Don't come back again soon!

entries.text: 我可不喜欢别人浪费我的时间。做完事情前，别再那么快回来！
entries.source_text: 我可不喜欢别人浪费我的时间。做完事情前，别再那么快回来！

entries.text: Such as?
entries.source_text: Such as?

entries.text: 比如说？
entries.source_text: 比如说？

entries.text: Well, let's say you did try and kill Killian, and your assassin failed. That means you need a new one to do the job right.
entries.source_text: Well, let's say you did try and kill Killian, and your assassin failed. That means you need a new one to do the job right.

entries.text: 好吧，让我们这么说，你确实试过去杀基利安，而你的刺客失败了。那意味着你需要另外的人来把这事儿做好。
entries.source_text: 好吧，让我们这么说，你确实试过去杀基利安，而你的刺客失败了。那意味着你需要另外的人来把这事儿做好。

entries.text: Huh? Oh, never mind.
entries.source_text: Huh? Oh, never mind.

entries.text: 哦呃？哦，没事儿。
entries.source_text: 哦呃？哦，没事儿。

entries.text: You know, 【Gizmo sighs】 I don't like it when people insult me in my own place. Izo, escort our guest out . . . through the window.
entries.source_text: You know, 【Gizmo sighs】 I don't like it when people insult me in my own place. Izo, escort our guest out . . . through the window.

entries.text: 你知道，【吉斯莫叹了口气】我不太喜欢人们在我的地盘上侮辱我。艾佐，把我们的客人请出去吧……横着，从窗户那里扔出去！

entries.text: You're back. You know, I had to hire someone else to do your work.# That didn't make me happy. In fact, Izo will show you just how unhappy I am. I hope you had a nice day. It was your last.

entries.text: 你回来了。告诉你，我又雇了其他人去干你的活儿。我很生气，后果很严重。事实上，艾佐会让你知道我究竟有多么生气。祝你愉快。这是你的最后一天了。
entries.source_text: 你回来了。告诉你，我又雇了其他人去干你的活儿。我很生气，后果很严重。事实上，艾佐会让你知道我究竟有多么生气。祝你愉快。这是你的最后一天了。

entries.source_text: 【吉斯莫呼哧呼哧着说。】我，呃……现在不太想讨论这个。

entries.text: You know, I found something very interesting after you was last here. If there's one thing I can't stand more than a lousy pepperoni pizza, it's a snitch. Boys!

entries.text: So it comes down to this, Killian. Well, I never could put up with your stink, and now I'm gonna put an end to it!

entries.source_text: 【Gizmo grunts.】 Killian's the mayor of this town. Thinks he knows everything . . . well, 【Gizmo laughs】 we'll just see how much he knows, won't we?

entries.text: 【吉斯莫咕哝着。】基利安是这里的镇长。自以为无所不知……好吧，【吉斯莫笑着说】我们就很快就会知道他到底全知全能到什么程度了，不是吗？

entries.text: 【Gizmo coughs.】 That's me, stupid. I run the . . . gambling establishment here.
entries.source_text: 【Gizmo coughs.】 That's me, stupid. I run the . . . gambling establishment here.

entries.text: 【吉斯莫咳喘着。】就是我，傻瓜。我在这儿经营着……一些赌博产业。

entries.text: That's Killian's place the north end of town. He sells crap.
entries.source_text: That's Killian's place the north end of town. He sells crap.

entries.text: 基利安住在镇子北边的尽头，卖些垃圾货。
entries.source_text: 基利安住在镇子北边的尽头，卖些垃圾货。

entries.text: Well, most people gamble here. You ask stupid questions.

entries.text: 大多数人在这儿都是赌博。你问了个傻问题。
